Hey there! I'm a dual-class specialist combining Digital Communication with Big Data & AI.

Originally from Cartagena (Murcia), I currently split my time between Murcia and Madrid, bringing a unique hybrid profile to the table. I'm an alumna of CEU San Pablo, where I completed my Master's in Big Data & Artificial Intelligence.

My skillset spans every corner of Digital Marketing: from Influencer Management and Content Creation to deep Metric Analysis. I don't just post; I strategize. I bridge the gap between technical data and creative storytelling, ensuring every decision is backed by stats and every campaign hits the heart.

Right now, I'm putting this hybrid profile to work as Data Analyst & Head of Social Media at THEX, where I lead content creation, community management, and data-driven digital strategy. I also manage the social media of Instituto Élan de Sexología and of the THEX and KEMET projects.

Featured project · Master's thesis Grade 9/10

Valoralia Systems

An Automated Valuation Model (AVM) for the Madrid housing market that combines classic tabular data with visual information extracted from listing photos using convolutional neural networks (ResNet50).

  • 7,968 real listings from Pisos.com
  • 42 zones across the Community of Madrid
  • 104,291 interior photos processed

The hybrid XGBoost model proves that adding 50 visual PCA components improves predictive power over a purely tabular model.

Continuous AI Training

My AI practice is supported by structured training and continuous experimentation. I focus on understanding what each model does best, building repeatable workflows, improving prompts and combining generative tools with traditional design principles rather than relying on one-click outputs.
